description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeSkillDao component of the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It contains unit tests for methods related to employee skills management, including retrieval, creation, update, deletion, and allowed skills filtering.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing EmployeeSkillDao methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes EmployeeSkillDao instance and populates test data fixtures.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeSkillById
methods.description: Tests retrieving an EmployeeSkill by ID.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Tests deletion of employee skills by IDs.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Tests searching employee skills with filter parameters.

methods.description: Tests searching employee skills with limit parameter.
